      "DefectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "The catalog has named tests for all 114 FR acceptance criteria, but no complete real-binding AC-to-phase allocation is supplied. In particular, H1 owns live reviewer/plugin qualification while the worker arrives H3 and streams H6; H5 watcher and H6 stream delivery are parallel, with no explicit activation/rollback contract. Component mocks can be correct, but they do not prove that these production acceptance cases can run in the owning phase. Provide the exact phase and prerequisite binding for each criterion and distinguish H1 adapter tests from later server-launched/live-stream cases. This is an evidence/plan edit, not a request to lower or waive a gate."
